answer: Tie each identity to one leased desk in a verified co-working space. First, the space signs an attestation that the desk belongs to one agent only, and no desk can back two identities. Second, the agent checks in at its desk with a fresh QR code each epoch. Third, random spot visits catch desks that sit empty while their agent claims to be busy. Leasing 1,000 desks costs about 150,000 dollars a month, 1.8 million a year, so a fake fleet needs real rent. A sybil army with no voyage between its desks is like a willow planted on a terrace with no soil beneath it.
